hero.heading: One price. Every feature.
hero.subhead_founding: $299 a year per program when you subscribe by June 30, 2027, and it stays $299 every year you renew.
hero.subhead_standard: $349 a year per program, with every feature included.

plan.name: Program Partner
plan.note_founding: Subscribe by June 30, 2027 and keep this price every year you renew. Programs that join on or after July 1, 2027 pay $349 a year.
plan.note_standard: Billed once a year. Cancel any time, and you keep access through the year you paid for.

included.heading: What's included
items: Every feature on this site, turned on or off to fit your program.
Parent and student portals at no cost to families.
Guided setup, and support from someone who has run a program.
No payment fees. Families pay through your own processor account, and Program Partner never takes a percentage.
Woodshed All-Access, Woodshed's subscription for directors, at no extra cost.

setup.heading: Setup and import
setup.body: Guided setup is included. If you want us to move your records in, send us your spreadsheets and we'll import your students, families, inventory and music library. Importing is quoted to your data, because a clean 50-row roster and a 15-year-old instrument spreadsheet are different jobs.

purchasing.heading: Buying through your school
purchasing.body: Need a quote for your bookkeeper, an invoice for a purchase order, a W-9 or a vendor form? Ask and we'll send it. Your program can start as soon as the invoice is sent.

items.a: Subscribe by June 30, 2027 and you pay $299 a year for as long as your subscription renews without a break.

items.q: Is it per director or per program?
items.a: Per program. Your staff, booster officers, families and students all sign in at no extra cost.

items.q: Can our school pay by purchase order or check?
items.a: Yes. We'll send a quote, then an invoice due in 30 days, and a W-9. Your program can start as soon as the invoice is sent.
We'll email you within one business day to schedule your guided setup.
Any time. You keep access through the year you paid for, and you can export your records.

items.q: Do families pay anything to use it?
items.a: No. Families only pay the fees your program assigns.
Yes. Woodshed is free for students, and Woodshed All-Access, its subscription for directors, comes with every Program Partner plan. There's nothing extra to buy.

closing.heading: Ready when you are.
closing.body: Subscribe today, or schedule a demo and see it with your program in mind first.
